coder.Author: coder
coder.Text: When an operator is pressed, I assess whether a calculation is pending or if the first operand is already set, ensuring correct state transitions. If a previous result exists and another operation follows, I preserve the current value as the new first operand. For equality operations, I determine which value to use based on whether the user is continuing a sequence or has just entered an operator. This approach maintains intuitive behavior consistent with standard calculator expectations.
